name: app-red-crypto-cover-with-floating-stat-cards-and-hand-held-history-screen
title: Red Crypto Cover with Floating Stat Cards
whatItIs: A red-to-black vignette cover with vertical stripe chart shapes, a hand holding a tilted phone with a transactions history screen, two floating stat cards (Realized PL in white, Projected Growth in red), a two-logo lockup, a project pill and a large headline 'A Smarter Way to Trade & Swap Digital Assets'.
whatItMeans: Floating stat cards break the screen's boundary to highlight key numbers, and red on black is intense and confident.
techniques: Floating stat cards outside the phone
Headline with alternating bright and dim words

vocabulary.definition: A metric card placed outside the device to emphasise a number.
A chart made of vertical thin lines.
Logos placed in rounded white squares.
